__NOTOC__
==Usage==
Simply place the template inline where needed.

The usage of the credits template is laid out in:
*[[Wookieepedia:Layout Guide/In-universe#Infobox]] &mdash; regarding its usage in in-universe infoboxes
*[[Wookieepedia:Manual of Style#Credits]] &mdash; regarding its usage in quotes, while limited from most aspects of prosified content
:→<small>See [[Forum:CT:Standardizing the use of "Credits" in infoboxes]], [[Forum:CT:Standardizing the use of "Credits" in infoboxes, part 2]], [[Forum:CT:Credits template - MoS]]</small>

{{Para|legends}} is optional. If provided and non-empty, it will link [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|Galactic Credit Standard]] (the Legends article); and otherwise, it will link [[Galactic Credit Standard]].

==Example==
===Code===
<code><nowiki>"This speeder cost {{Cr}}5,000!"</nowiki></code>
===Result===
"This speeder cost {{Cr}}5,000!"
